watches.name: Marine 39 Ti
watches.description: Over the past two decades, Dievas has cultivated a loyal following through models like the Time-Attack, Shadow, and Focal, defining the standard for dependable and purposeful tool watches. In 2025, we revisited our core line of hybrid divers, refining the execution while retaining the mechanical integrity that fundamentally defines the brand. The result is the new Vortex—a compact, re-engineered instrument conceived for precision, resilience, and daily versatility. Building on the strong reception of the original, this latest evolution of our signature model once again combines rigorous engineering and purposeful design. Now reimagined in a more versatile and compact form, the case measures 39.5mm and is constructed from our proprietary UltraWerkTM Titanium, elevating its durability and maintaining a sleek, mechanical profile.

watches.name: Solaris 39 Ti Limited Edition
watches.description: Building on a decade of heritage established by models like the Vortex, Time-Attack, Shadow, and Focal,Dievas presents the new Solaris, a refined modern compact interpretation of our proven hybrid-diver formula. This instrument honors the legacy of its predecessors, such as the original Vortex—a watch born not for display, but for professionals navigating the world's most unforgiving environments, from pressure-blackened depths to foreign terrain. The 2025 Solaris collection represents a refresh of our core line, preserving the brand's distinctive DNA while refining the design for contemporary expectations of comfort, capability, and build quality. This particular Limited Edition, restricted to only 30 pieces, is a striking evolution of our engineering philosophy, distinguished by the supplementary use of forged carbon in its construction and a truly unique orange-salmon dial, fully rendered in carbon—a powerful, modern expression of German precision and strength.

watches.name: Maya Mk III Green Ceramic Bezel
Maya Mk III Vintage Blue/Red Ceramic Bezel
watches.description: For the first time, Dievas came out with the idea of personalisation on the timepieces. The MAYA MK III allows its wearer to easily swap a new bezel colourway at any point in time. The one-piece ceramic insert is done in matte finishing to match the Teutonic case and comes in two designs - one in the whole tone and the other in two-tone. Each purchase of the MAYA bezel comes with bezel screws and a tool, allowing you to remove and interchange any of the bezels easily.

watches.name: Marine Mojave
watches.description: Since the company's conception in 2006, Dievas Watch Company has forged an astute reputation amongst watch collectors and enthusiasts alike for their striking good looks, reliability, innovation, and exceptional value. The company with German's undisputable engineering philosophy. Has succeeded in molding a cohesive blueprint that is culpable for current and impending Dievas watch collections that illustrate not only striking originality but also embellishing classic lines, reminiscent of specific historical vintage watches. For more than a decade, the Vortex, Time-attack, Shadow, and Focal models have been endlessly providing watch enthusiasts quality and robustness with timekeeping everywhere they are daily with over-built specifications. Now in 2019, Dievas found the right time to revamp and improve their collections while keeping their classic DNA. We now like to introduce to you the all-new Marine Mojave that fits today's customer perception of how a reliable timepiece should wear and built.
